text:
maria: PR opened for AstraX-8B model-card updates. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/492
eli: looking
eli: what's the seq limit we're publishing? current bench says 8k but runtime shows 6k for quantized
sam: bench from 2026-03-15: 8k tokens @ p99 320ms on p4d-24
kevin: runtime compatibility note: INT4 fallback to FP16 for long context, should call out
maria: good catch @kevin — add a compatibility row: INT4 -> FP16 when seq > 4096
nate: SDK snippet needs update for sdk/v2 streaming API; old snippet uses sdk.v1.generate
maria: here's proposed snippet:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.models.generate('astrax-8b', input='Explain Redwood batching', max_tokens=128, stream=False)
print(resp.text)
```
lina: small nit: use `client.from_env()` not `Client()` to pick up region/key in examples
maria: updated
doc-bot: lint results: docs/language/astrax-8b.md: line 73 - missing compatibility table row (severity: warn)
doc-bot: docs/language/astrax-8b.md: line 112 - code-block flagged for py3-compat (fixed?)
eli: also need throughput numbers for embeddings; different endpoint 'embed-2' used in bench
sam: I have embeddings.csv in bench-results bucket: s3://redwood-bench/astrax/2026-03-15/embeddings.csv
maria: added link + small table showing 8k seq vs 4k quantized perf
kevin: add a note about KV-cache invalidation when switching model variants (e.g., astrax-8b -> astrax-8b-quant)
maria: added kv-cache note
nate: can someone double-check the "limits" section phrasing: ops teams want explicit SLO wording
lina: propose: 'recommended max_seq: 8192 for FP16; for INT4 prefer ≤4096; operation may fallback' 
maria: pushed one more commit to the PR, requesting review from @eli @sam @kevin
eli: reviewing now :eyes:
sam: quick approve for benches, leaving doc wording to @eli
kevin: approved the compatibility notes👍
maria: thanks, merging after docs-ci passes
